findings.problem: The final product of the patent carries purity_pct 96.3 but mass_g and yield_pct null, although the text prints an isolated mass and yield for it in all five examples and raw-compounds.json holds every one of them.

findings.artifact_says: quantity {mass_g: null, volume_ml: null, mmol: null, equivalents: null, yield_pct: null}, purity_pct 96.3, section_label 'Technical Field'

The cause is in pipeline/finalise.py merge_compound: the guard 'v not in (None, "", [], {})' treats an all-null quantity dict as populated, so the Technical Field record's empty dict overwrites Example 5's. findings.problem: Thirteen further records lose every printed quantity to the same merge overwrite, so a compound charged with a mass and a mole figure in five examples reads as quantity-free in the artifact.

checks_passed.what_was_verified: All 54 records validate against pipeline/schemas/compounds.schema.json: no field outside the schema, no required field (patent_id, identifier, identifier_type, role, section_label) null or empty, every section_type and physical_form inside its enum. id and compound_uuid are present but are added by finalise.py from (patent_id, identifier), which is the documented contract, not an A1 leak.

No record carries a structure or a computed property: smiles is null in all 54 records, and there is no molecular formula, molecular weight, InChI or enrichment field anywhere in the artifact. The SMILES read from the two schemes appear only inside aliases, on 1,3-cyclohexanedione, tembotrione and compound I, which is what A1 rules 4b and 4c ask for.

Every one of the 152 provenance entries quotes a Chinese string that occurs verbatim on the source line it cites, checked programmatically over all entries after normalising fullwidth brackets and commas. No record is unanchored, and no condition, atmosphere or default value appears anywhere in the artifact that the text does not print.

Both drawn structures were re-read on p02 and p04 substituent by substituent against the SMILES the spans encode. Structure I: methyl ester at C1, Cl at C2, CH2Br at C3, SO2CH3 at C4. Structure II: COOH at C1, Cl at C2, CH2OCH2CF3 at C3, SO2CH3 at C4. Structure III: a six-membered ring with the two carbonyls in a 1,3 relationship. Structure IV: the same aryl pattern acylating the carbon between the two carbonyls of the cyclohexane-1,3-dione ring. Every ring position matches; nothing was inferred from chemical knowledge in place of the page.

Reagents above and below the arrows were not merged. In scheme (2) the page writes 缩合剂 above the arrow and 碱催化剂 below it, and the span keeps them as two separate conditions entries. In scheme (1) MOH/M2CO3 is the only text above the arrow and the span records it as a condition rather than as a reactant.

The prior-art route of [0002] was not annotated as the invention's route. Its compounds (2,2,2-trifluoroethanol, potassium tert-butoxide, thionyl chloride, acetone cyanohydrin) carry section_label Background or Beneficial Effects, is_section_product false, and no quantity; the only record with is_section_product true is tembotrione.

All five step a isolations close on C11H10ClF3O5S at 346.70 g per mol from a 1.0 mol charge: 314.8 g is 90.8 per cent against a printed 91, 321.7 g is 92.8 against 93 (twice), 311.4 g is 89.8 against 90, and 318.3 g is 91.8 against 92. Every step a mass and yield pair in the artifact is internally consistent to within rounding.

Every populated quantity in the artifact matches the pair printed on its cited line, re-read on the page images: 1.2mol(48g) sodium hydroxide and 1.0mol(318g) compound I and 300mL water on p05, 1.2mol(67.2g) potassium hydroxide and 2mol(758g) HBTU and 3mol(405g) HOBT and 1mol(152g) DBU on p06, 1.2mol(28.8g) lithium hydroxide and 1.8mol(291.6g) CDI and 318.3g compound II on p07. Units were read as printed: mol became mmol, mL became volume_ml, and no value was converted or derived.

No temperature range was flattened and no reflux was recorded as a number, because compounds.json holds no temperature field at all; the ranges the examples print (5-10, 8-15, 15-20, -10-8 and 20-30 degrees C) live in reactions.json. purity_pct 96.3 is the figure printed in Example 5 and purity_method is null, which is correct: the text prints 纯度 with no method in all five examples.

The hazards A1 rule 20 lists were checked against this document. 丙酮氰醇 is rendered acetone cyanohydrin, not cyanoacetone. 二氯亚砜 is thionyl chloride. 环磺酮 is tembotrione, with the record explicitly rejecting sulcotrione (磺草酮), and the artifact follows the Chinese common name over the EN gloss on line 37, which reads 'a cyclic sulfone ketone (huanhuangtong)' and names no specific compound. 二甲苯 is left resolved false for the unstated isomer. 二氯乙烷 in Example 3 is kept verbatim and unresolved rather than read as the 1,2 isomer of Example 1.

The record 甲、醇 is a faithful transcription, not a transcription error: p06 line [0034] prints 减压浓缩加甲、醇打浆, with the enumeration comma inside the name, and the record keeps it verbatim, leaves it unresolved, and explains it in notes instead of correcting it to 甲醇. The Example 3 charge 1.5mol(147g), the Example 4 charges 1mol(98g) and 1mol(152g)吡啶, and the Example 5 charge 5mol(690g)碳酸钾 were all confirmed on p06 and p07 as printed, including where they fall outside the ranges claims 5 and 7 allow.

role, identifier_type, section_type, physical_form and purity_method are inside their closed lists in all 54 records. Every tag is category:value with a lowercase snake_case ASCII value and no duplicates, and no tag encodes physical_form, color, role_seen or commercial, which rule 19 forbids. The only exceptions are the two tag findings above.

Every record carrying a populated quantity has a section_label whose text prints that quantity, 13 of 13 checked line by line, so the section-label-versus-content defect found in the reference run does not recur here. The 26 records labelled Summary of the Invention are all quantity-free, which is what that section prints.
